justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/member/HandleInvocation.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/member/HandleInvocationTest.java. The target class is only 63 lines, has one field, one constructor, and one behavior method (`apply`); it performs a single responsibility: emitting an `invokeExact` call and computing stack impact. The tests cover only two straightforward cases (stack increasing/decreasing). There is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large method count, or separable cohesive groups, so insufficient modularization is not present.
